_comment: Laminate electrical properties, transcribed from the sources named
per entry on the dates named per entry.
SMALL ON PURPOSE. pcb-toolkit carries 45 substrate presets, and they
were extracted from the Saturn PCB Toolkit binary rather than taken
from manufacturer datasheets; its own README calls them compatibility
data and not manufacturer data. Copying them here would turn an
acknowledged approximation into what looks like a reference table. So
this holds only entries read off a datasheet, and the way to get the
rest is to add them to YOUR profile's own laminates file, where they
travel with the project and carry your source rather than someone
TWO DIELECTRIC CONSTANTS, which is the trap this file exists to make
visible. Rogers publishes a PROCESS value (clamped stripline,
IPC-TM-650 2.5.5.5, at one frequency) and a DESIGN value
(differential phase length, over a band). They differ by about 5%,
the design value is the one to size an impedance with, and a table
carrying a single 'er' silently picks one. Both are carried, and
er_design is null where a manufacturer does not publish one.

laminates.name: RO4003C
laminates.er_design_conditions: 8 to 40 GHz, differential phase length method
laminates.tg_note: Published as >280 degC by TMA, a lower bound rather than a single transition point
laminates.source: Rogers RO4000 Laminates RO4003C and RO4350B data sheet
laminates.source_caveat: Read from third-party reproductions of the Rogers data sheet, not from rogerscorp.com. Check the current revision before a design relies on it.

laminates.name: RO4350B
laminates.er_design_conditions: 8 to 40 GHz, differential phase length method
laminates.tg_note: Published as >280 degC by TMA, a lower bound rather than a single transition point
laminates.source: Rogers RO4000 Laminates RO4003C and RO4350B data sheet
laminates.source_caveat: Read from third-party reproductions of the Rogers data sheet, not from rogerscorp.com. Check the current revision before a design relies on it.

laminates.name: JLCPCB 7628 prepreg
laminates.er_process_conditions: As published on JLCPCB's impedance page for its 7628 templates; the measurement conditions are not stated there
laminates.tg_note: Not published alongside the impedance templates
laminates.source_caveat: A fab's figure for its own stack, not a laminate datasheet. JLCPCB does not state which supplier's glass-epoxy this is, and the number has no measurement conditions attached, so it is usable for JLCPCB's own templates and should not be carried over to another fab's FR-4.

conventions.name: FR-4 (generic)
conventions.note: NOT a material specification. 'FR-4' names a flammability rating, not a formulation, and its permittivity varies with the glass style, the resin content and the frequency. Carried as a RANGE so it cannot be mistaken for a datasheet figure. Use the laminate your fab actually presses, or the er in that fab's own stackup template.
